# dsh-fish
English | 中文

**dsh摸鱼小组件：** A reasoning-style dock above the DeepSeek Harness Web UI
composer. It is a human-only

surface: the row is rendered entirely on the
client, is not a session event, and does not affect the

real conversation or
the model's output. The plugin registers no model-facing tool and no prompt
se

conversation or
the model's output. The plugin registers no model-facing tool and no prompt
section.
Two apps share the same row:

- **Stocks** — a watchlist that reads like one line of reasoning.
- **Reading** — TXT / EPUB books s

tored on the DSH host, with host-backed
progress that survives page reloads and is shared across bro

on the DSH host, with host-backed
progress that survives page reloads and is shared across browsers.
## Install
Requirements:

- DeepSeek Harness with the Web UI (this plugin is a `dsh.bundle`).
- Node.js 20 or newer on the hos

DeepSeek Harness with the Web UI (this plugin is a `dsh.bundle`).
- Node.js 20 or newer on the host.
Install from GitHub:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Restart DeepSeek Harness after the install so the Host half and the client
bundle are loaded.
For development, install the working copy as a link:

Then open a conversation and run `/fish`.
## Use

- `/fish` — open the fish app picker.
- `/fish stock` — turn on the stock watch directly.
- `/fish n

ovel` — turn on the reading app directly.
- `/fish off` — turn the current session's fish row off.
-
`/fish status` — print the active app.

`/fish`, `/fish stock` and `/fish novel` are host commands. The bare `/fish`
picker is also decorate

d as a client-side popup; selecting an app there does
not write a command event. The direct forms ap

pear as a normal command row in
the conversation.
### Stock watch

- Collapsed: one reasoning-like line showing the focused symbol.
- Click the line to focus it. Press

shes immediately, `J` / `K` (or arrows and `[` / `]`) move the
focused symbol, and `1`–`9` jump to a

symbol.
- `Esc` collapses the row while it has focus.
- Refresh every 5 minutes by default; the int
erval is configurable.
### Reading

Import books on **Settings → fish → Reading**. Files are uploaded to the DSH
host and stored under `

$DSH_HOME/fish`; they are not sent to the model and are
not written into the session log.

- **Collapsed = single-line**. The row shows one visual line of the current
book. Long lines wrap na

turally; the row scrolls one visual line at a time.
No book title, chapter name, page number or book

-specific hover tip is shown.
- **Expanded = multi-line**. A page is 10 visual lines by default (6–1

4 is
configurable). A page turn moves one viewport; auto-turn still moves one
visual line at a time.

- **Content anchor**. Progress is stored as a character position, not a page
number. Changing font

size, line count, window width or collapsing the row
returns to the same text instead of the same pa

ge index.
- **Per book**. Every book keeps its own position; opening another book and
coming back re

sumes where you left it.
- **Cross browser**. Books, the active book and progress live on the DSH ho

st.
A second browser on the same host sees the same shelf and the same position.
- **No blank pages*

*. Blank lines between paragraphs are collapsed on import,
so a single-line turn never stops on an e

mpty page.
- **Auto turn**. One visual line per tick; paused while the tab is hidden and
while the r

ow is hidden by the boss key.
- **Mouse wheel**. While the pointer is over the reading row, the whee

l moves
one visual line. The wheel is left alone in the shelf list.
Supported formats:

- **TXT** — UTF-8, UTF-16LE / UTF-16BE (BOM) and GB18030.
- **EPUB** — ZIP (stored / deflate), `cont

ainer.xml`, OPF spine, NCX and
EPUB3 navigation, XHTML text. Images, CSS, footnotes and DRM are not

rendered. DRM-protected EPUB is rejected.
- Project Gutenberg header/license blocks are stripped. Te

xt-derived Gutenberg
EPUBs are re-chaptered from their own Chinese chapter headings instead of
being

treated as a dozen arbitrary XHTML chunks.
- **Not supported**: PDF, MOBI, AZW3, online book source

s. Those need
format-specific infrastructure that does not belong in this small app.

Host limits: 64 MB per uploaded file, 20 million characters of parsed text,
[该节后续省略]
### Reading shortcuts

Global shortcuts work while the reading panel is open, even when the composer
has focus. They requir
e at least one `Ctrl` / `Alt` / `Cmd` modifier.
| Action | Global | When the reading row has focus |
| Next / previous page | `Alt + J` / `Alt + K` | `J` / `K`, `→` / `←`, `↓` / `↑`, `Space` / `Shift +

Space`, `PageDown` / `PageUp` |
| Next / previous chapter | `Alt + N` / `Alt + P` | `N` / `P` |
| N

ext / previous book | `Alt + ]` / `Alt + [` | `]` / `[` |
| Open library | `Alt + L` | `L` |
| Toggl

e auto-turn | `Alt + O` | `A` |
| Toggle expanded | `Alt + G` | `E` / `Enter` |
| Hide / restore | `

`Alt + O` | `A` |
| Toggle expanded | `Alt + G` | `E` / `Enter` |
| Hide / restore | `Alt + H` | — |

Every binding is configurable on **Settings → fish → Reading**. In the shelf
list, `J` / `K` or the

arrow keys move the selection, `Enter` opens, and
`Esc` returns to reading.
### Global shortcuts

Global shortcuts work while any fish panel is open, even when the composer has
focus. They always re

quire at least one `Ctrl` / `Alt` / `Cmd` modifier so
ordinary typing is not captured.
Defaults:

- hide / restore: `Alt + H`
- expand / collapse: `Alt + G`
[该节后续省略]
## Privacy and boundaries

- No book text is placed in the conversation, the session log or model
context. Chapters are fetched

by the browser from authenticated same-origin
routes only.
- Stock quotes are fetched by the Host f

rom `qt.gtimg.cn` and
`web.ifzq.gtimg.cn`; the browser never calls those third-party endpoints
direc

tly.
- Uploaded files are stored below `$DSH_HOME/fish` with owner-only permissions.
Deleting a book
through Settings removes its parsed content from the host.
